title: "Downloading EcoAtlas Project Data"
format: html

```{r}
library(reticulate)
```

```{python}
import requests

# Base URL for the API
base_url = "api.ecoatlas.org/projects/{region_type_key}/{region_key}"

# Specify the note name to download
note_name = "region_type_key"

try:
    # Send a GET request to the API, enabling streaming for large file responses
    response = requests.get(f"{base_url}/notes/{note_name}", stream=True)
    
    # Raise an HTTPError for bad responses (4xx and 5xx status codes)
    response.raise_for_status()
    
    # Define the filename for storing the downloaded content
    file_name = f"downloaded_{note_name}"
    
    # Open the local file in binary write mode
    with open(file_name, "wb") as file:
        # Iterate over the response data in chunks
        for chunk in response.iter_content(chunk_size=1024):
            file.write(chunk)

except requests.exceptions.HTTPError as http_err:
    # Handle HTTP errors
    error_message = response.json().get('error', 'Unknown error')
    print(f"HTTP error occurred: {http_err}\nError: {error_message}")
except requests.exceptions.RequestException as err:
    # Handle other request exceptions
    print(f"Other error occurred: {err}")
```

```{r}
#| label: load data

# Set paths
restoration_ecoatlas_url <- "api.ecoatlas.org/projects/{region_type_key}/{region_key}"
data_dir <- "data"
restoration_file <- file.path(data_dir, "restoration_ecoatlas.txt")

# Download data if not already cached
if (!file.exists(restoration_file)) {
  message("Downloading file...")
  dir.create(data_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  download.file(
    url = restoration_ecoatlas_url,
    destfile = restoration_file
  )
  message("Saved to: ", restoration_file)
} else {
  message("Using cached file.")
}
```
